sources.entry: Magento Open Source - Leading provider of open omnichannel innovation. (Source Code) OSL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Magento Open Source is the open-source core of the Magento PHP eCommerce platform for building an online store.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a short landing page rather than full documentation. It describes Magento Open Source as software that provides basic eCommerce capabilities for building an online store from the ground up. It links to sections for quick start install, system requirements, prerequisites, and more installation options, plus a help center. It explains how to contribute code, report issues, and improve developer and end-user documentation, and describes the community maintainer role. It also covers security reporting, Slack and other community channels, and the OSL 3.0 licensing terms.
use_cases: set up a basic eCommerce website
contribute to an open-source PHP eCommerce platform
how_to_run: See the Quick start install section linked from the README
Check the System requirements and Prerequisites sections before installing
Consult More installation options for other setup methods
notable: Open-source core of the Magento eCommerce platform
Community maintainer program for reviewing and merging pull requests
The README points to Adobe Commerce as the full-featured commercial alternative
Each source file is licensed under OSL 3.0 unless a separate ordering agreement applies
caveats: The README says Magento Open Source offers basic eCommerce capabilities; the full-featured option is the commercial Adobe Commerce, which adds cloud architecture, hosting, and AI-powered merchandising and analytics
Commercial ordering agreements with Adobe or Magento can supersede the OSL 3.0 license for individual files
